reviewedFrom: B11.3 definition of done (advisor-plans/013) and docs/books-revenue-recognition.md (home closing).

sale-relief-by-component.derivation: Lot 1 carries $60,000 of land brought in at start, $200,000 of construction and $2,500 of the $3,000 interest paid (the eligible part). Completion moves it all to 1170; the sale relieves exactly that, one cost-of-sales line per component. The buyer paid a $20,000 deposit and was refunded $5,000, so $15,000 is applied; the neighbour's $15,000 deposit stays a liability. Revenue is the $400,000 price.

costs-after-the-sale.derivation: A $3,000 grading bill dated 20 July is entered after the 25 July sale while July is open: it reached 1170 and is relieved on the sale date. A $1,200 touch-up dated 3 August is cost of the sold home in August, expensed and labeled. July then closes with the controls tying; a bill dated 28 July cannot post into closed July — it waits as a closed-period finding and July's cost of sales is unchanged.

reviewed-development-allocation.derivation: $1,000.01 of shared utilities is split by front footage 60/45/45: 400.004/300.003/300.003 dollars floor to 40000/30000/30000 cents, and the one leftover cent goes to the largest remainder (lot D1). Nothing posts until a different member approves; the proposer is refused. Each lot's land is $10,000 plus its share; $199.99 of the $1,200 site cost stays on the development job.

expected.selfApproval: refused: approved by someone other than the proposer

warranty-consumption.derivation: The sold home's $5,000 reserve is provided at closing. A $800 repair billed after the sale lands in cost of sales (5000); approving it against the visit moves it onto the reserve: 2260 is debited $800 and the same 5000 account is credited, so cost of sales is not overstated and the reserve ties to the visit.

closing-reversal.derivation: Reversing the closing on 20 August refunds the wire, reverses the deposit application (the $15,000 returns to 2300), credits the $400,000 sale in full, returns each relieved component to 1170 and withdraws the $5,000 warranty provision. Every home balance except cash then equals its position immediately before settlement; the neighbour is untouched. A reason under ten characters is refused.
